name: Ecstatic Beauty
oracle_text:
Exile the top three cards of your library. You may play those cards until end of turn. Put four time counters on each of those cards that has suspend.
Suspend 4—{R}
blocked_sentences: Exile the top three cards of your library. You may play those cards until end of turn. Put four time counters on each of those cards that has suspend.

needs.what: a selector key matching a card whose printed characteristics include suspend (`CardDef.suspend` is set), e.g. `has_suspend: true`, usable over an `as` binding of exiled cards, so an effect can act on 'each of those cards that has suspend' and only those
needs.why_existing_wont_do: selector_keys has no such key and suspend is a card-level cost key, not one of the `keywords` a `keywords` selector can read; the `suspend` op filters nothing and also grants suspend to cards that lack it (Doom's Time Platform), so applying it to all three exiled cards would suspend cards the printed text leaves alone

needs.what: putting N time counters on a card that already has suspend and is already in exile must make it suspended (702.62b: exiled, has suspend, has a time counter -- the engine's `suspended_by` mark from `suspend.make_suspended`), so the upkeep tick and the free cast pick it up, while it also stays playable this turn under the same effect's `playable: this_turn` permission
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `add_counters` on an exiled card puts time counters nothing ticks and never sets `suspended_by`; the `suspend` op does call `make_suspended` but has no way to restrict itself to cards that already have suspend (see the selector need above)
